title: Cobblebuilds: Sounds
body:
CobbleBuilds: Sounds is a resource pack addon for [CobbleBuilds: Leaders](https://modrinth.com/project/RALBUk5i) that adds battle themes to trainer battles.

Featured music

All music featured in this pack was made by [Zame](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKKKbeAhjKYJfOy5Opg8lcQ). - Battle! Kanto Gym Leader: Remaster ► Pokémon Fire Red & Leaf Green - Battle! Hoenn Gym Leader: Remaster ► Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire & Emerald - Battle! Sinnoh Gym Leader: Remix ► Pokémon Diamond, Pearl & Platinum - Battle! UNOVA GYM LEADER: Remaster ► Pokémon Black 2 & White 2 - Battle! Kalos/Galar Gym Leader: Remix ► Pokémon X & Y/Sword & Shield - Battle! Kanto Trainer: Remaster ► Pokémon Fire Red & Leaf Green - Battle! Hoenn Trainer: Remaster ► Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire & Emerald - Battle! Unova Trainer: Remastered ► Pokémon Black & White - Battle! Kalos Trainer: Remaster ► Pokémon X & Y

Disclaimer

Monetization is **disabled** for this project
